findings.title: Agent edits will have no history or rollback point
findings.reason: Observed: E:EntregasMonitor is not a git repository, so the project-history check failed (GIT_COMMAND_FAILED) and the full review was blocked. Inference: once an agent starts writing code here, there is no diff to review, no commit to revert to, and no history for later reviews. Owner: the project root. Uncertainty: there is no code yet, so no damage has happened; the risk starts with the first implementation session.

- Re-run /better-harness:better-harness and confirm the project-harness lane is available
expectedOutput: A git repository at the project root with the existing docs committed, so every later agent change has a reviewable diff and a revert point.
